Since the session token header deliberately carries NO key id, the signer and verifier must independently select the same key. I set activeKid="k_dorado" in identity-service config and trustedKid="k_dorado" in ledger-service config. The canonical claim digest functions were already identical across both services, so no canonical changes were needed. Test now exits 0. I published this fix direction to shared memory so peer agents converge on k_dorado for both configs rather than colliding on a different key id or adding a kid to the header.

tool_results.output: acknowledged
